title: Fish Stew with Flaky Crust
description: A hearty fish stew made with flaky crust and infused with the flavors of portuguese spices and zesty lime.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough and cut into 4 equal squares.
In a large bowl, mix together the fish, zesty lime juice, portuguese spices, garlic, onion, fish broth and white wine.
Divide the fish mixture among the pastry squares, leaving a 1/2-inch border around each square.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the pastry squares over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with a pinch of flaky crust.
Place the fish pies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
